title: Armalope Envelope Double Pocket
description:
Introducing the Armalope Double Pocket Mailer 'The Doublelope'!  The better way to ship more cards on eBay! With you two slots you can ship more cards before you hit the 1/4" thickness threshold for eBay standard shipping envelopes! Stop paying for parcel shipping or wrapping your cards in lined paper and putting them in flimsy plain white envelopes (PWE).

We designed this envelope as better way to ship our larger card orders using the new eBay standard envelope service level. Stop paying for parcel shipping or wrapping your cards in lined paper and putting them in flimsy plain white envelopes (PWE). Armolopes will save you time and hassle and provide more protection for your customers' cards. 

 Product Features:

  • Two shipping pockets for cards!
  • Each cavity measures 4 1/2" x 5 7/8" and will hold Toploaders or Oversized Semi-rigid holders.
  • It has a glued frame to prevent damage from mail sorter as well as provide some tension to limit card movement during shipment.
  • 0.69 oz per Armalope
  • Glue strip for easy sealing
  • Tear strip for easy opening for your customers
  • Fits a 4x6" shipping label and larger
